yvonne.en: The description of the ultimate was reworded; the effect did not change. A bug that could stop Yvonne from performing a finisher was fixed.
yvonne.zh-TW: 終結技的描述文字經過調整，實際效果不變。修復特定情況下無法處決敵人的問題。

laevatain.en: Three bugs fixed: two that miscounted Melting Flame stacks on the enhanced battle skill's extra hit, and one that ended Twilight early when a battle skill was cast just before it ran out.
laevatain.zh-TW: 修復三個問題：兩個是強化戰技追加攻擊的熔火層數計算異常，一個是終結技結束前施放戰技會使終結技提前結束。

laevatain.en: The description of Twilight was reworded to say that Smouldering Fire and Seethe do not shorten it; the effect did not change.
laevatain.zh-TW: 黃昏的描述補上「施放焚滅或沸騰不會縮短持續時間」，實際效果不變。

last-rite.en: A bug that could keep the combo skill from applying Solidification was fixed.
last-rite.zh-TW: 修復特定情況下連攜技無法凝結敵人的問題。

last-rite.en: A bug where the combo skill could cut Tangtang's ultimate short was fixed.
last-rite.zh-TW: 修復特定情況下施放連攜技會提前打斷湯湯終結技的問題。

ember.en: Two bugs fixed: abnormal behaviour when hit by a multi-hit attack while casting the battle skill, and the third basic attack losing its target.
ember.zh-TW: 修復兩個問題：施放戰技期間受到多段攻擊時表現異常，以及第三段普通攻擊失去目標。

da-pan.en: A bug where the ultimate and the combo skill could lose their target was fixed.
da-pan.zh-TW: 修復特定情況下終結技、連攜技失去目標的問題。

avywenna.en: Two potentials were fixed to match their descriptions: Carrot and Sharp Stick had the wrong effect, and Doubling Down could activate when it should not.
avywenna.zh-TW: 兩項潛能修正為與描述一致：恩威並施的實際效果與描述不符，籌碼加倍會在不該生效時生效。

antal.en: The name of the Chinese voice actor was updated.
antal.zh-TW: 更新了中文語音配音演員的姓名。

gilberta.en: A bug that kept finisher damage from receiving certain bonuses was fixed.
gilberta.zh-TW: 修復特定情況下處決傷害無法獲得特定加成效果的問題。

alesh.en: A bug that kept finisher damage from receiving certain bonuses was fixed.
alesh.zh-TW: 修復特定情況下處決傷害無法獲得特定加成效果的問題。

alesh.en: A bug where the battle skill could not trigger certain weapon skill effects once the potential Super Salty Comeback was unlocked was fixed.
alesh.zh-TW: 修復解鎖潛能鹹鱗翻身後，施放戰技無法觸發部分武器技能效果的問題。

fluorite.en: A bug that kept finisher damage from receiving certain bonuses was fixed.
fluorite.zh-TW: 修復特定情況下處決傷害無法獲得特定加成效果的問題。

fluorite.en: The wording of the Slow effect in the battle skill description was reworded; the effect did not change.
fluorite.zh-TW: 戰技描述中關於減速效果的文字經過調整，實際效果不變。

tangtang.en: Two bugs fixed: the status icon of the ultimate did not last as long as the effect, and Last Rite's combo skill could cut the ultimate short.
tangtang.zh-TW: 修復兩個問題：終結技的狀態圖示顯示時間與實際效果不同步，以及別禮的連攜技會提前打斷終結技。

tangtang.en: The description of the ultimate was reworded to say that it applies Immobilization; the effect did not change.
tangtang.zh-TW: 終結技的描述改為「對範圍內的敵人施加一段時間的定身」，實際效果不變。

rossi.en: The wording of the Critical Rate boost in the battle skill description was reworded; the effect did not change.
rossi.zh-TW: 戰技描述中關於暴擊率提升的文字經過調整，實際效果不變。

arcane.en: A bug that could cause abnormal SP return and damage after casting the battle skill in the Array Arcana: INT form was fixed.
arcane.zh-TW: 修復處於「陣訣·智」形態時，特定操作可能導致施放戰技後技力返還及傷害異常的問題。

liino.en: A bug where the first hit of the battle skill interrupted an enemy's charging state an abnormal number of times was fixed.
liino.zh-TW: 修復戰技初次命中敵人時，打斷敵人蓄力狀態次數異常的問題。

zhuang-fangyi.en: A bug where Ultimate Energy did not return to its earlier state when leaving a dungeon after casting the ultimate was fixed.
zhuang-fangyi.zh-TW: 修復開啟終結技後退出副本時，終結技能量未正確回到進入副本時狀態的問題。
